en: Color aerial view of a small European town surrounded by forests and low hills. A main road with 1960s–1970s era cars runs from the foreground across a bridge toward the distant part of town. Low-rise buildings with red-tiled roofs and detached houses are interspersed with many trees and patches of water. In the bottom right, a building with an orange awning reads "VERTSHUS KAFETERIA." Another sign by the road has the logo and letters "OK," likely for a fuel station. The overall scene suggests a calm, green town in a Nordic country.
